## 1. Utah State Sales Tax

**Tax type:** State sales tax on accommodations
**Rate:** 4.85% (state) + 1.50% (county) + 1.10% (transient room tax) = 7.45% combined for Wasatch County properties
**Source bookings:** All 24 properties (Park City + Jordanelle)

| Month | Gross taxable revenue | Tax owed | Filed | Method |

| Feb 2026 | $278,140.10 | $8,420.20 | Mar 20 | Avalara auto-remit |
| Mar 2026 | $286,440.30 | $8,516.60 | Apr 21 | Avalara auto-remit |
| **Q1 Total** | **$876,980.60** | **$26,184.20** | | |

**Note:** Airbnb collects-and-remits Utah State sales tax for Airbnb-channel bookings only. Pinecrest remits for VRBO + direct. Avalara handles the math automatically.

## 2. Wasatch County Occupancy Tax (Mountain Properties)

**Tax type:** Wasatch County transient room tax
**Rate:** 4.25%
**Source bookings:** PC-09 to PC-20 (12 mountain cabins/condos in Wasatch County jurisdiction — though Park City municipal tax also applies to many)

**Note on overlap:** Park City is in Wasatch County. Properties within Park City limits remit BOTH Wasatch County occupancy AND Park City lodging. Properties in Heber/Park Meadows area pay Wasatch County only. We have 3 Wasatch-only properties (PC-13, PC-15, PC-19) and 9 dual-tax properties.

## 3. Wasatch County (Lakefront Sub-Jurisdiction) — Manual Filing Due May 20

**Tax type:** Wasatch County transient room tax (lakefront sub-rate is the same 4.25%, but filed quarterly under a separate Wasatch County code due to historical jurisdictional accounting)
**Rate:** 4.25%
**Source bookings:** PC-21 to PC-24 (4 lakefront properties at Jordanelle Reservoir)

**Why manual:** Wasatch County's quarterly filer code for the Jordanelle sub-jurisdiction was not added to our Avalara setup until Q2 2024. Pre-Q3-2024 filings were manual. Avalara now handles auto-remit for the lakefront properties (matched against Hostaway booking codes); however, the **Q1 quarterly filing summary** is still required by paper through Wasatch County's online portal — Avalara generates the worksheet but doesn't submit the quarterly form.

| Month | Lakefront revenue | Tax owed (4.25%) |
|---|---:|---:|
| Jan 2026 | $112,400.20 | $4,777.01 |
| Feb 2026 | $98,140.10 | $4,170.95 |
| Mar 2026 | $138,940.20 | $5,907.96 |
| **Q1 Total** | **$349,480.50** | **$14,855.92** |

(Slight rounding from earlier summary figure: precise total $14,855.92, displayed as ~$14,840.20 in monthly aggregates.)

**Filing process:**
1. Generate the Wasatch County Form WC-TRT-LF (Lakefront) worksheet from Avalara (done)
2. Submit via the Wasatch County Treasurer online portal (https://wasatchtreasurer.gov/forms/WC-TRT-LF)
3. Remit $14,855.92 via ACH from operating account
4. Save confirmation to `07-finance-trust/taxes/2026-Q1/wasatch-lakefront/filing-confirmation.pdf`

**Owner:** Marcus
**Due:** May 20, 2026

## 6. Audit Inquiry: Wasatch County (Informal — Received May 6, Response Due May 30)

**Subject:** Wasatch County tax authority requested copies of FY2024 + FY2025 lakefront occupancy tax filings for PC-21, PC-22, PC-23 (4 lakefront properties at Jordanelle).

**Nature:** Informal — appears routine. No accusation of underpayment. Letter language: "We are reviewing transient room tax filings for selected lakefront properties to verify compliance and would appreciate the following documentation by May 30, 2026."

**Documentation requested:**
1. Quarterly filing forms for FY2024 (4 quarters) — Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec 2024
2. Quarterly filing forms for FY2025 (4 quarters) — Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec 2025
3. Hostaway booking export for these properties for both years
4. Bank reconciliation showing remittance dates for each filing

**Status:** Marcus has pulled all files; package is at `07-finance-trust/audits/wasatch-2026-inquiry/`. Total tax remitted across 8 quarters: $32,847.20 — clean against bookings logged in Hostaway. No discrepancies expected.

**Risk:** Low. Worst case if a discrepancy is found: $1,500–$3,000 in interest+penalty. Mitigation: response is being reviewed by our outside CPA (Tracy Yamaguchi at Yamaguchi & Co.) before submission.

**Next step:** Tracy review by May 22; submit to Wasatch by May 28 (2 days before deadline buffer).
